'''Sordaan Xris' Safari Partners''' was a big game-hunting excursion company owned and founded by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Sordaan Xris]]. It served adventures from all over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|344}}</ref> operating out of the [[Rodian Hunting Grounds]].<ref name="SWG">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sordaan Xris' Safari Partners appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online role-playing game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
